subtasks: Put car objects into the left basket, watch objects into the middle basket, and chocolate_bar objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.
Place the held Snickers chocolate bar fully inside the right red basket.
Use the right arm to pick up the red Snickers chocolate bar near the center of the table and put it inside the right red basket.
Place the three wristwatches into the middle blue basket. Use the left arm for the leftmost watch and the right arm for the other watches.
Put both toy cars into the left white basket. Use the right arm to bring each car to the center of the table for the left arm to pick up and place in the left basket.
Pick up the red race car near the center of the table with the left arm and place it fully inside the left white basket.

Place the overturned red race car in front of the blue basket into the left white basket with the left gripper, and place the white chocolate wrapper just to its right into the right red basket with the right gripper.
Return both open grippers to their initial poses after clearing the basket rims.
